description.zh: 允许推送时自动创建仓库
description.en: Whether to automatically create a repository when an image is pushed.
The default configuration for automatically created repositories.

description.zh:
默认仓库类型，取值：

- `PUBLIC`：公开仓库

- `PRIVATE`：私有仓库
description.en:
The default type for automatically created repositories. This parameter applies only if `AutoCreateRepo` is set to `true`. Valid values:

- `PUBLIC`: a public repository

- `PRIVATE`: a private repository

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr update-namespace --instance-id cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000 --namespace-name test --auto-create-repo true --default-repo-type PRIVATE --default-repo-configuration example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr UpdateNamespace --region cn-hangzhou --NamespaceName test --DefaultRepoType PRIVATE --InstanceId 'cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000' --AutoCreateRepo true --DefaultRepoConfiguration 'example-string'
